target_name: Innovation Capital Net of Net Debt
rationale: Once R&D is coalesced to zero for the ~85–90% of firms that don't report it, the expression collapses to (cash − debt)/assets, so the signal is dominated by the well-documented net-leverage/cash-holdings return relations rather than any knowledge-capital interaction, and summing a ~0.05-magnitude R&D term with a ~0.3-magnitude net-debt term guarantees the intangible leg contributes almost no cross-sectional variation.

This is the archived "Internally Funded Innovation Solvency" signal with the product swapped for a rank sum and a 3- instead of 5-year window — exactly the cosmetic functional-form variant the objective warns against, and the additive form also destroys the conditional ("cash-backed innovation") logic the hypothesis claims, since a firm can now score high on solvency alone with zero R&D.

Introducing a genuine second moment (cash-flow volatility × leverage as a default-boundary proxy) interacted with intangible intensity is a substantively new mechanism relative to the levels-only gen-0 set, the negative sign is consistent with the distress-anomaly direction, and the xad/xrd coalesce keeps coverage broad — though the volatility×leverage leg alone is close to Campbell–Hilscher–Szilagyi territory, so the incremental value hinges on the intangible interaction surviving a control for that leg.

The wedge algebraically reduces to (debt/at)·(intan/(at−intan)), i.e. a smooth product of leverage and intangible share, which is economically the same construct as the archived goodwill×debt-burden signal (ls_talpha=−3.23) with `intan` substituted for `gdwl`, and it is numerically explosive for firms where intangibles approach total assets.

target_name: R&D-Adjusted Pretax Income Repair Under Leverage
rationale: Moving the rank-repair construction from the retained-earnings stock to flow profitability is a defensible extension and the leverage conditioning is coherent, but the rank difference between pi/at and (pi+xrd)/at is close to a monotone relabeling of R&D intensity (a known anomaly), so the design must be able to show it is not simply R&D-intensity × leverage; note also the positive expected sign sits in tension with the archived evidence that intangible-heavy levered firms underperform.

Using gross margin as a broad-coverage proxy for unrecorded brand/organizational capital is a legitimate way out of the 5–14% R&D-reporter slice and the false-distress mechanism is coherent, but the construction risks being a distress-tilted repackaging of the well-known gross-profitability anomaly, so it needs to demonstrate incremental power over gross profitability and over the leverage/RE distress legs separately.
